'''BobaofFett Hidden Base, the STAR WARS blue deck.''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[BobaofFett]]
* '''Published:''' 10 April 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 HB BobaofFett LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Bo Shek (V), Luke Skywalker (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

This is the first deck of four. The first four I've made in nearly 3 years.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 59: RALLTIIR is listed under Starting and again under Locations; counted once (the headers total 60 counting it twice).
* Posted 'Don't do that again' (a starting card) dested the Tatooine Effect, not the Reflections III shield.
* Original-era (V): Bo Shek (V), Luke Skywalker (V) (VS1).

== Strategy ==

(first off i can't spell for the life of me so bear with me)

These are the first decks I've mad in three years and this is the first of my four deck series.

Your starting System is Ralltir and you should try to deploy that first and Dantooine last. Dantooine is the only system that dosen't have a dark side force icon and this will hopfully cause your opponint to think this is your hidden base(little bit of phsycological warfair). Use REBEL FLEET and IT COULD BE WORSE to slow down force drain and help absorbe battle damage. once you have all the X-WINGS out use ALL WINGS REPORT IN and get back that eight force.

Try to get VERRACK on the DEFIANCE and if you can manage it don't deploy S-FOILS until RED LEAER IN RED 1 is on table. Use luke to get DARKLIGHTER SPIN in to hand and have him be retriving 1 fore a turn as much as possible.

Since this is one of my first decks that I've made in 3 years I would appriciate as much feed back as possibel. BE BRUTAL I CAN TAKE IT!
